title: Run Pre-deploy Tests
bottom_line: Run it after the plan. Test agents record every bug with steps, captures and a fix prompt, then you choose Fix or Skip per bug.

sections.heading: Run it after the plan, in the app's repository

blocks.caption: No arguments. It reads the sessions that /pre-deploy-tests:plan wrote in .pre-deploy-tests/.

blocks.text: It changes no app code and commits nothing: test agents only test and record. If the run stops, run it again; it resumes at the first unfinished session.

blocks.title: What each platform copy needs
rows: `playwright-cli`; WebKit and Firefox are installed once on first use
macOS with Xcode and an iPhone simulator (an iPad one for tablet sizes)
`adb` and an emulator image (a tablet one for tablet sizes)
`ffmpeg`, optional: without it iOS clips stay `.mov`

sections.heading: Fix what preflight finds, or continue without it

nodes.label: Missing ones listed
nodes.note: Fix them and continue, or continue without them.

nodes.label: Session marked blocked
nodes.note: The reason is kept and the run goes on.

blocks.text: Test credentials come from the environment variables the plan named. Their values are never printed or saved.

sections.heading: Choose how many agents run at once

cards.title: Local default branch
cards.text: Each copy gets its own worktree, app and database. You get a suggested number of lanes from the machine's cores and free RAM, and can type another.

cards.title: Integration environment
cards.text: One agent at a time, so agents never change each other's data. No question asked.

blocks.text: The suggestion is the smallest of: the copies in play (a simulator or emulator counts as two), half the cores, and free RAM minus 4 GB divided by 4 GB.

sections.heading: Review the bugs and mark Fix or Skip

blocks.title: Each bug card shows
items: Title, severity (Blocker, Major, Minor, Cosmetic), area, and every place it occurs.
What it means for a user, expected and actual result, steps, and how often it reproduced out of 3.
A screenshot for a static bug, a recording for a bug with movement, and the reproduction script.
The suspected cause and a ready-to-use fix prompt.

cards.title: Not ready
cards.text: Any Blocker or Major bug, or any planned session that could not be tested.

cards.title: Ready
cards.text: Every session complete and no Blocker or Major bug.

blocks.caption: The verdict at the top of the page.

blocks.text: The page is a private Artifact; share it from claude.ai. Choices are shared with everyone who opens it, and only editors can change them. Bug files stay in `.pre-deploy-tests/bugs/`.

next_action.text: Run `/pre-deploy-tests:run`, then mark each bug Fix or Skip on the page.
next_action.detail: Bugs marked Fix are what /pre-deploy-tests:fix works through.
